pattern.description: Clicking into the 'Paste a link' field reveals an inline lavender hint panel (copy, integration logos, Learn more / Dismiss); the form rows beneath are pushed down to make room. Happens in one frame, synced to 'I can add'.
pattern.why_premium: Captured as a real product interaction timed to the narration, so the viewer sees the integrations affordance at the exact moment the voiceover introduces adding insights; the reflow keeps the panel in context instead of a modal overlay.

build_hint.gsap: Recreated smoothly: gsap.fromTo(panel, {height: 0, autoAlpha: 0}, {height: 'auto', autoAlpha: 1, duration: 0.3, ease: 'power2.out'}); content below follows naturally via layout (or gsap.from(belowRows, {y: -190, duration: 0.3, ease: 'power2.out'})); then gsap.from(panel.children, {autoAlpha: 0, y: 6, stagger: 0.04, duration: 0.25, ease: 'power2.out'}, '<0.1'). Source is a hard step (set at frame), so a gsap.set is the faithful replica.
build_hint.remotion: const p = spring({frame, fps, config: {damping: 30, stiffness: 220, mass: 1}}); panel height = interpolate(p, [0, 1], [0, 190]); opacity = p; rows below translateY tied to the same height so they reflow in lockstep. Faithful replica: show panel when frame >= start (no tween).

notes: Source is a screen recording; the panel appears between f1428 and f1438 with no visible tween (single energy spike), so durations are near-step guesses. Pattern choice layout_reframe (panel insertion + reflow); notification_pop was considered but the panel is inline, not an overlay. No SFX candidates.
